text: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed CopilotKit, and created the runtime endpoint and frontend components exactly as documented. The copilot endpoint demonstrably works: `curl http://localhost:3000/api/copilotkit/info` returned a real HTTP 200 with `{"version":"1.72.0","agents":{"default":{"name":"default","className":"BuiltInAgent"...}}}`, confirming the runtime is serving. However, `npm run build` repeatedly timed out or was killed, and no valid `OPENAI_API_KEY` was present in the sandbox environment, so I had to use a placeholder that would prevent actual chat responses from OpenAI. The dev server was running and compiling the frontend when the budget ended.
